text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident PDR-8273 triggered for service=redwood-embeddings, severity=high. Alert: canary-embed-2026-v2 - p95 latency spike > 5s and 503s on replica set r-canary-11. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PDR-8273

alice (SRE): acked in pagerduty, looking. pulling logs now.

carol (eng-oncall): I see 50% error rate on canary shards r-canary-11 across us-west-2, traces show kv-cache misses THEN tokenizer timeout.

bob (ML Eng): flagged during rollout — model quant path change + new tokenizer vectorizer. Not expected at scale.

alice (SRE): quick healthcheck: `kubectl get pods -l app=embed-service,rollout=canary -o wide` shows 3/5 pods Ready on r-canary-11, OOM+killed on two.

alice (SRE): logs snippet: ```
2026-02-12T22:17:03Z ERROR embed: tokenization failed: timeout after 2.0s
2026-02-12T22:17:04Z WARN runtime: kvcache miss for prefix abc123
2026-02-12T22:17:04Z ERROR http: 503 downstream timeout
```

carol (eng-oncall): Binding a temporary traffic diversion to stable is safest. Can we drop canary traffic to 0% while we triage?

bob (ML Eng): agree. I suspect quantized kernels blow up under certain sequence lengths. Will reproduce locally but push rollback path first.

alice (SRE): initiating traffic diversion via rollout controller. Command: ```
# divert canary -> stable
curl -X POST https://console.redwood-infer/api/rollouts/divert \
  -d '{"target":"embed-service","from":"canary","to":"stable","percent":100}' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

incident-bot: rollout-divert job started (job-id j-88f3).

pagerduty-bot: PDR-8273 acknowledged by alice. Escalation stopped.

dan (Support): Support queue: multiple customers reporting errors from embedding bulk API, one enterprise account (acme-inc) reported 12 failures in last 10m. Creating support incident and notifying customer success.

eve (PM): tagging product impact — docs/integrations could get noise. Please confirm whether feature flags were toggled for this release.

alice (SRE): diversion applied, canary traffic now 0% (verified via metrics: canary request count -> 2/min). p95 on stable back to baseline ~120ms.

bob (ML Eng): thanks. I'll run automated regression on the canary image and start a rollback patch. If it's kernel/quant combo we may need to pin quantization profile to v1.

carol (eng-oncall): while bob triages, can we spin up extra stable pods incase of load? `autoscaler` already at 120% but I'll bump to 140%.

alice (SRE): scaling stable: `kubectl scale deploy/embed-service-stable --replicas=8` -> done. No elevated error rates now.

bob (ML Eng): reproduced locally with sequence lens ~1024 and quant-profile=v2 — tokenizer gets into a high CPU loop and KMS calls backpressure happens. Patch ready: revert tokenizer change and pin quant-profile to v1.

bob (ML Eng): propose two options: 1) rollback canary image to embed-2026-v1 (fast) 2) patch canary to fix tokenizer (slower). Recommend rollback then test a smaller canary with patched image.

alice (SRE): agree. Rollback plan: `kubectl set image deploy/embed-service-canary embed-service=redwood/embed:2026-v1 --record` then monitor for 10m.

carol (eng-oncall): I'll run the preflight smoke check post-rollback: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}\n' https://embed.redwood/api/v1/embeds/health` repeatedly.

incident-bot: rollbacks started (rb-2026-11). PagerDuty note updated.

pagerduty-bot: PDR-8273: status -> mitigated (traffic diverted, rollback in progress).

alice (SRE): rollback applied. Rolling update status: 5/5 stable-ready, canary pods terminating.

carol (eng-oncall): smoke checks green: 200 0.12s, repeated 10x. No 5xx observed.

dan (Support): emailed acme-inc with interim update: "We've diverted traffic away from the recent canary. We're rolling the release back and monitoring. We'll follow up after postmortem."

eve (PM): good. Please add a deploy-hold until we finalize root cause and regression test for embeddings.

bob (ML Eng): created PR with tokenizer revert + additional unit tests for edge sequence lengths. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/embed/branches/revert-tokenizer-2026

alice (SRE): creating incident ticket: INC-2026-embed-canary-regress with timeline, mitigation steps, affected customers list.

carol (eng-oncall): assigning followups: - SRE to confirm no other hosts impacted - ML Eng to validate patch in staging - Support to collect customer logs - PM to coordinate comms.

incident-bot: Summary appended to PDR-8273: "Canary embed-2026-v2 caused high p95 and 503s due to tokenizer/quant interaction on long sequences. Traffic diverted and canary rolled back. No ongoing customer outages. Postmortem scheduled."

alice (SRE): marking the thread resolved in Slack but will keep the channel open for any re-escalation. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

bob (ML Eng): follow-up: will run a canary run with quant-profile=v1 + added smoke harness for sequence=1024, and request an SRE review before any new canary rollouts.

dan (Support): recorded support ticket SUP-5509 for acme-inc.

eve (PM): scheduling a 1hr postmortem review tomorrow 10:00 PST. Invitees: SRE, ML Eng, Support, Product.

alice (SRE): final note: ROI of diversion was quick — traffic diversion + rollback removed customer errors within ~7 minutes from pager firing. Will include timings in postmortem.
